result.topic_en: A table of 4×4 arrays of small integers for the primes 5, 13, 29, 37, 53 and 61, each followed by two rows of pairwise sums. The structure suggests counts of the kind used in biquadratic residue theory (cyclotomic numbers of order 4), but the page gives no explanation.

methods.what: For each prime $p\equiv 5 \pmod 8$ from 5 to 61, a 4×4 array of non-negative integers is tabulated. In every case each row sums to $(p-1)/4$.
Beside each array stand two rows of numbers formed from sums of entries of that array. Each pair of rows has a symmetric pattern a b b a / b a a b.
